definitions.gloss: local cuisine; regional dish; local specialty food
definitions.explanation: Traditional dishes associated with a particular region, using local ingredients and cooking methods passed down through generations. Composed of 郷土 (homeland, local area) + 料理 (cooking, dish).

USAGE:
{郷土料理|きょうどりょうり} is a common term in travel, tourism, and food culture. Each prefecture and region in Japan has its own {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}, and exploring them is a major part of domestic travel.
